name: token-meter
description: Context, tokens and money for the models your gateway serves: a live band, a per-model ledger, prices you set, and a budget guard that compacts before the window fills.

showBand.title: Show the meter band
showBand.description: Draw context usage, session spend and the last turn's tokens above the prompt.

compactAt.title: Compact at (percent)
compactAt.description: When the context window reaches this percentage, compact once. 0 turns the guard off.

warnAt.title: Warn at (percent)
warnAt.description: Show the context figure in warning colour from this percentage on.

dailyBudget.title: Daily budget (USD)
dailyBudget.description: Warn once a day when the estimated spend passes this. 0 turns the budget off.

paneRows.title: Pane height
paneRows.description: Rows the meter pane asks for while seated inline.
